note_en: Notice 居然 in 小智居然会记住陈阳提过的每一个小细节 "Xiaozhi actually remembered every little detail Chen Yang had mentioned." 居然 goes before the verb and signals the speaker's surprise that something happened against expectations, a feeling English conveys with tone or words like "actually" or "of all things." Note too 提过: 过 marks that he had mentioned it at some point in the past, which English expresses with "had ever mentioned."
